title: Load test and statement timeout choices
decision: One shop of the size NFR-005 names among 5 000 ordinary ones; 50 reads a second beside the writes; the driver runs as a separate process over HTTP against four application processes; a statement of the API is cancelled after 5 seconds and one of the worker after 60, answered with 503 TIMEOUT; two indexes on the ledger were added; the overview of a very large shop was left over its target because curing it needs a stored balance or a changed target, which is the founder's choice under launch criterion 6
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 43
rationale: The requirements give the targets but not the mix of traffic, and say nothing of a query that runs away
